mapper.select: SELECT d.id, d.dname, d.dtype, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) as employee_count, COALESCE(SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight), 0) as total_workload, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN w.work_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) THEN w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight ELSE 0 END), 0) as monthly_workload, COALESCE(AVG(w.quality_score), 0) as avg_quality_score FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON d.id = e.depart_id LEFT JOIN biz_workload_detail w ON e.id = w.staff_id GROUP BY d.id, d.dname, d.dtype ORDER BY total_workload DESC

SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM sys_department) as total_departments, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT id) FROM hr_employee) as total_employees, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(time_spent_hrs * task_weight) FROM biz_workload_detail), 0) as total_workload_hours, COALESCE((SELECT AVG(quality_score) FROM biz_workload_detail WHERE quality_score IS NOT NULL), 0) as avg_quality_score, COALESCE((SELECT MAX(dept_workload) FROM ( SELECT d.id, COALESCE(SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight), 0) as dept_workload FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON d.id = e.depart_id LEFT JOIN biz_workload_detail w ON e.id = w.staff_id GROUP BY d.id ) dept_stats), 0) as max_department_workload, COALESCE((SELECT d.dname FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON d.id = e.depart_id LEFT JOIN biz_workload_detail w ON e.id = w.staff_id GROUP BY d.id, d.dname HAVING SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight) DESC LIMIT 1), '暂无') as top_department

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(w.work_date, '%Y-%m') as month, SUM(w.time_spent_hrs * w.task_weight) as monthly_workload, COUNT(DISTINCT w.id) as task_count, AVG(w.quality_score) as avg_quality FROM hr_employee e JOIN biz_workload_detail w ON e.id = w.staff_id WHERE e.depart_id = #{departmentId} AND w.work_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 6 MONTH) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(w.work_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month

select d1.id,d1.dname,d1.dtype,d1.dtel,d1.dfax,d1.description, d1.supdepartment, COALESCE(d2.dname,'顶级部门') as supdepartment1, date_format(d1.establishmentdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as establishmentdate1, d1.parent_id,d1.order_num,d1.leader_id from sys_department d1 left join sys_department d2 on COALESCE(d1.parent_id, d1.supdepartment) = d2.id
limit #{startIndex}, #{pageSize}

select d1.id,d1.dname,d1.dtype,d1.dtel,d1.dfax,d1.description, d1.supdepartment, COALESCE(d2.dname,'顶级部门') as supdepartment1, date_format(d1.establishmentdate,'%Y-%m-%d') as establishmentdate1, d1.parent_id,d1.order_num,d1.leader_id from sys_department d1 left join sys_department d2 on COALESCE(d1.parent_id, d1.supdepartment) = d2.id where d1.id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT d.id, s.id FROM sys_department d LEFT JOIN staff s ON s.depart_id = d.id WHERE d.supdepartment = #{id} OR s.depart_id = #{id}

SELECT p.id, p.pname, p.ptype, p.post_level, p.organization, p.requirements, COUNT(DISTINCT e.id) as employee_count FROM sys_post p LEFT JOIN hr_employee e ON p.id = e.post_id AND e.depart_id = #{departmentId} WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM hr_employee e2 WHERE e2.depart_id = #{departmentId} AND e2.post_id = p.id ) GROUP BY p.id, p.pname, p.ptype, p.post_level, p.organization, p.requirements ORDER BY p.id
